messages.author: 4f6f5f995ee31178
messages.subject: grey-shaded code: not if processing Rmd or md in RStudio?
parts:
When I process an R script with spin() I get
the R code on a grey rectangle and using a blue font in the resulting
html file,
but if I process either rhe Rmd or the md files (also created by spin()) in RStudio, I
do not get the rectangles.
Is there anything I'm doing wrong or is it that RStudio understands
the formatting codes in a different way?

Thanks

Agus

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] grey-shaded code: not if processing Rmd or md in RStudio?
parts:
My guess is you customized the markdown rendering function in
~/.Rprofile and you were using Pandoc instead of the built-in markdown
renderer: http://www.rstudio.com/ide/docs/authoring/markdown_custom_rendering
I'm fairly confident that the output minitest_logv2.html was rendered
via Pandoc.

Regards,
Yihui
